clauses.summary: Meaningful names always — no shorthand, no filler words

flag.name: shorthand parameter
filler variable
flag.source:
declare const loadAccount: () => string;
export const data = loadAccount();

flag.name: destructured filler binding

allow.name: domain compound names
allow.source:
export const accountData = { greeting: "hello" };
export const renderGreeting = (incomingRequest: { readonly userName: string }): string => `Hello, ${incomingRequest.userName}`;

allow.name: property key named data
allow.source:
export const response = { data: 1 };
export const total = response.data;
